mapper.select: SELECT p.emp01_person_id AS person_id , p.emp01_company_id AS company_id , p.emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm , p.emp01_email_addr AS email_addr , to_decrypts(p.emp01_password) AS dec_password , p.emp01_office_telno AS office_telno , p.emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , f_org_parent_full_nm(t.emp03_org_code_id, t.emp03_trans_date) AS parent_full_nm , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', t.emp03_pos_cd, p.emp01_company_id, t.emp03_trans_date) AS pos_nm FROM emp01_person p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT emp03_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date, emp03_pos_cd FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = p.emp01_person_id ORDER BY emp03_trans_date DESC, emp03_trans_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON TRUE WHERE p.emp01_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT cmp10_mail_book.cmp10_mail_book_id AS mail_book_id , cmp10_mail_book.cmp10_email_addr AS email_addr , cmp10_mail_book.cmp10_note AS note FROM cmp10_mail_book INNER JOIN cmp11_mail_role ON cmp11_mail_book_id = cmp10_mail_book_id WHERE cmp10_email_addr || COALESCE(cmp10_note, '') LIKE #{searchText} AND cmp11_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT cmp10_email_addr AS email_addr , to_decrypts(cmp10_password) AS dec_password FROM cmp10_mail_book INNER JOIN cmp11_mail_role ON cmp11_mail_book_id = cmp10_mail_book_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = cmp11_person_id WHERE UPPER(cmp10_email_addr) LIKE UPPER(#{emailAddr}) AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1

SELECT sys01_loc_nm AS location_name , sys01_company_nm AS company_name , sys01_mail_info AS mail_info , COALESCE(sys01_mail_log_yn, 'false') AS mail_log_yn FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{apprId} UNION ALL SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_file_id IN ( SELECT apr05_file_id FROM apr05_relate_doc WHERE apr05_appr_id = #{apprId} ) ) AS file ORDER BY file.sys10_file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr10_mail_history ( dcr10_mail_history_id, dcr10_doc_id, dcr10_apr_id, dcr10_person_id, dcr10_sender_email, dcr10_send_time , dcr10_receiver_email, dcr10_referencer_email, dcr10_attached_file, dcr10_pdf_file, dcr10_seal_file , dcr10_title_text, dcr10_body_text ) VALUES ( #{id}, NULL, #{req.apprId}, #{personId}, #{req.senderEmail}, f_sysdate() , #{req.receiverEmail}, #{req.referencerEmail}, NULL, NULL, NULL , #{req.titleText}, #{req.bodyText} )
INSERT INTO dcr11_mail_file_history ( dcr11_mail_file_history_id, dcr11_mail_history_id, dcr11_file_id ) VALUES ( f_create_seq(), #{mailHistoryId}, #{fileId} )
